AHT20.footprint: AHT20 LGA sensor package or verified breakout-compatible SMD footprint
AHT20.placement: Place at board edge with vent opening; keep away from regulator, ESP32, USB connector heat, and status LED.
AHT20.routing: Short I2C stubs; no copper pour directly under sensing opening if using exposed environmental port.

BH1750.footprint: BH1750FVI WSOF-6 or selected module-compatible SMD footprint
BH1750.placement: Place near a board/window edge with a clear optical path; do not shadow with tall parts or enclosure ribs.
BH1750.routing: Keep light sensor area free from tall silkscreen labels, LEDs, and dark solder-mask obstructions.

SGP30.footprint: SGP30 DFN-6 or verified gas-sensor module footprint
SGP30.placement: Place at board edge with airflow slots; keep away from adhesives, conformal coating, and hot regulator area.
SGP30.routing: Avoid planes or components blocking the sensing port; leave assembly note that sensor must not be washed/coated.

BMP280.footprint: BMP280 LGA-8 or verified pressure-sensor module footprint
BMP280.placement: Place where pressure port is exposed to ambient air; avoid enclosure compression and direct airflow jets.
BMP280.routing: Keep sensor top port unobstructed; no glue, flux residue, or silkscreen over the vent area.
